headline: STT GDC Seeks $2.4 Billion Loan Amid AI Data Centre Financing Expansion
summary: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres is seeking a $2.4 billion loan as financing expands for artificial intelligence data centres.
why: Data centre operators require substantial capital to expand computing capacity required by global hyperscalers and artificial intelligence workloads.

impacts.name: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres
impacts.why: The company is seeking to secure a $2.4 billion loan to fund data centre expansion.
